lede: Documents the shadcn-flavored design system in this exemplar repo. Source of truth: src/styles/tokens.css and src/components/. The harness scaffolds the directory you're reading; team-authored content lives in the manifest, components-index, and per-page frontmatter.
rules: **Tokens always.** Never hardcode hex, px, or shadow values — consume `var(--*)` only.
**Pair, don't pick.** Every fill has a `-foreground` sibling. Use `--primary` with `--primary-foreground`, never with `--foreground`.
**One primary per region.** Two `default` buttons in the same view is a smell — pair primary with secondary or outline.
**WCAG 2.1 AA.** Semantic HTML, keyboard access, visible focus rings via `--ring`.
**Owned source.** Components live in this repo, not `node_modules` — fork patterns to extend, never override in place.
**No `node_modules` references in MDX.** Documentation imports must resolve from this repo or relative paths only.
**Forbidden: emojis.** Glyphs come from the team's icon library (`lucide-react`) — never inline emoji.
